card.name: Manual page headers and section headings
card.fires_on: Header tokens in Linux man page titles such as the section number, Linux, and Manual. Also fires on heading words like "What to expect at" and navigation separators.

modes.label: Man page header
modes.description: Parentheses, "Linux" or "Manual" in a repeated man page title line.

modes.description: Separator bars in page navigation text before a title.
